response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.avg_signed_amount, p.transaction_count, p.transaction_count * 1.0 / o.avg_transaction_count AS transaction_count_ratio FROM per_account AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
